description: This file defines a class for running Pylint code quality tests within an Odoo module, including executing Pylint on Python files in a given directory, parsing results, and generating an HTML report.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class for performing Pylint code quality checks on Python modules within an Odoo environment.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test class, setting name, note, minimum score, and other attributes.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes Pylint on Python files in the specified module path, parses the output, and generates a report.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the parsing results into a table for display.
